projectDescription: A schema-driven Next.js developer portfolio template powered by OlonJS — deploy to Vercel in one click to get a fully editable portfolio with a built-in Studio CMS, blog, case studies, and AI-ready MCP manifests.
keyFeatures: One-click Vercel deploy with Save2Repo integration
Built-in Studio CMS at /admin for live content editing
Schema-driven pages — every section validated by Zod contracts
Case studies / work portfolio with structured project data
MCP manifests for AI agent discoverability
Automatic sitemap, robots.txt, and JSON-LD SEO
Dark/light theme tokens with full CSS variable system
File-based content stored in JSON — no database required
TypeScript end-to-end with generated OpenAPI and client types
publicApiSurface: GET /:path*.json — rewrite alias for page JSON
POST /api/save-to-file — persist Studio edits to JSON (admin-protected)
